limitations: Polled child execution and owned cleanup are bounded. Synchronous filesystem reads are not preemptible; late final validation is rejected after 360 seconds.
Read-only installed macOS x64 Node22.13.1 observation under Rosetta; not Linux proof. Completion may include strict replay rejections.

ownedProcesses.scope: Only identities observed as this spawned Node child or its descendants. PPID, PGID and any user-data-dir are retained as provenance; every signal rechecks start time, UID and exact argv. No process-group/name-wide signals.
